svg.aria-label: HookRelay: Multi-Tenant Webhook Delivery Platform. Zero accepted events lost using a transactional outbox. SSRF-hardened ingestion, per-endpoint circuit breaker, and HMAC-SHA256 signatures. Built with Node.js, TypeScript, PostgreSQL, Docker.
